headline: Paul Kim drops Christmas single 'My Only One' Nov 27
sub: His second English single, with an MV he directed himself
source: Source: Y.ES Entertainment via Korean media
caption:
Paul Kim is getting festive with 'My Only One', a holiday single out November 27 at 2 PM KST.

It's his second English-language single after 'Love Me Hard' in October, a carol-style pop song he co-wrote. Paul Kim also made his debut as a music video director with its animated MV, and the teaser is already out.

📌 Source: Y.ES Entertainment, via Korean media (Sports Kyunghyang, Special Times)
